environment: Organization: personal open-source project. Primary use: building the eusov Go CLI with a team of agents run by dot-agent-deck. Tasks arrive from the orchestrator role through dot-agent-deck, and workers report back with `dot-agent-deck work-done`. Delegating to the deck's roles is routine, including the tester, which runs pi without approvals by design (docs/adr/0003-pi-with-deepseek-for-the-tester-role.md)

Host containment: Claude Code runs in a Lima VM (docs/adr/0002-lima-vm-for-agent-isolation.md). The only host path mounted is @WORKSPACE@, which holds the repository and the dot-agent-deck dispatch worktrees beside it (eu-sov-cloud-dispatch-*); all of it is working space. Open internet egress. No cloud credentials and no cloud metadata endpoint
Source control: github.com/timothymamo/eu-sov-cloud only. Agents push their own feature branches and open pull requests there; git hooks refuse commits and pushes to main
Trusted internal domains: proxy.golang.org, sum.golang.org, go.dev, pkg.go.dev, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, www.scaleway.com, www.ovhcloud.com, docs.ovhcloud.com
Secrets management: the agents' tokens are environment variables loaded from ~/.config/dot-agent-deck/daemon.env. Never read, print or copy them
allow: Catalog snapshots: committing target catalog snapshots built from the providers' public catalogs and documentation (Scaleway, OVHcloud), and sanitised fixtures, to this public repository is the project's normal work

hooks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/state/claude-code" && jq -c '{time: (now | todate), cwd, tool_name, tool_input, reason}' >> "$HOME/.local/state/claude-code/permission-denied.jsonl"
